description: Logs a check-in attempt on a contact, as the contact card's Log a check-in does: outcome reached (with sentiment positive, negative or neutral), no_answer, voicemail, callback_due or skipped; optional channel (call, sms, email, in_person, other) and note. Pass bookingId (read a booking) to attribute the check-in to a visit's assigned staff; staffOverrideIds names people explicitly. Nothing is sent. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat returns the same check-in.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: log_client_checkin
title: Log a client check-in
